name: Power Generation Technologies
summary: How electricity is produced: thermal, nuclear, hydro, wind and solar plants, energy storage, and the economics of generation.

topics.name: Energy resources and the generation mix
Thermal plants: Rankine, gas turbine and combined cycle
Wind energy conversion: turbines and generator types (DFIG, PMSG)
Solar photovoltaic systems: cells, modules, arrays, MPPT
Energy storage: batteries, flywheels, CAES, hydrogen
Generation economics: capacity factor and LCOE
